_note: 4 skill achievements (src/constants.js SPRINT_ACH_*/NO_HIT_ACH_*/NO_BONUS_ACH_*/BOULDER_MEISTER_*), added alongside ach_translations_pacifist.json in the same batch. Same array shape: [title, post-earned description, pre-earned description]. Play Console has ONE description field - use the pre-earned string there. Icons: achievement-icons/sprint.png, no_hit.png, no_bonus.png, boulder_meister.png (512x512 RGB, no alpha, not yet generated). Suggested points: sprint 30 (pace skill), no_hit 35 (survival skill, matches no_bonus), no_bonus 35, boulder_meister 30 (5-of-5 commitment). Hidden: No. Incremental: No (boulder_meister could be Incremental=Yes with steps=5 instead if the console prefers a progress bar over a single unlock - either works with the same live report() call).
